source_documents.title: Intramolecular Photoinduced Charge Transfer and Recombination Dynamics in Vinylarene Terminated Organosilanes

reference_evidence_units.quote: No photochemical changes were observed in UV− vis spectra collected before and after irradiation
reference_evidence_units.subject: organosilane measurement controls
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Approximately 1e-4 M dissolved solutions; stirred 2 mm cuvette; 360 nm pump, 200 fs time resolution.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Before/after UV-vis spectra show no detected photochemical change during transient measurements.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This controls persistent photochemistry, not ultrafast intermediate identity or aggregation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: they can all be classified as a charge-separated state
reference_evidence_units.subject: organosilane series
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Steady-state emission/excitation-derived reorganization energies across acceptors.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors classify emitting states throughout the studied series as charge separated.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Shared state character does not imply identical recombination kinetics; derived parameters depend on spectral assumptions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 334, 360, and 368 nm for Si2s-2E, Si2s-E,C, and Si2s-2C, respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: Si2s-2C with acceptor controls
reference_evidence_units.statement: Si2s-2C red-edge half-rise is about 368 nm; the authors place the optical sigma-pi* CT transition on this edge.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Half-rise is not an absorption maximum. Earlier E,C data are comparison, not target data.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Si2s-2C
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1 global sequential fits, DCM, 360 nm excitation; table visually checked.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Fitted hot-state relaxation is 2.8 +/- 1.2 ps and charge recombination 237 +/- 19 ps.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Kinetic-model estimates from TA, not fluorescence lifetimes or directly resolved reaction coordinates.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Si2s-2C
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 3 global TA fit, cyclohexane, 360 nm excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Relaxation is 2.4 +/- 0.5 ps and charge recombination 137 +/- 8 ps in cyclohexane.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Underlying cyclohexane TA traces are SI Fig. S7, not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: we do not see an enhancement in the charge-recombination lifetime for Si2s-2C
reference_evidence_units.subject: Si2s-2C solvent comparison
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Cyclohexane versus DCM; weak charge screening in nonpolar solvent.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors attribute faster recombination in cyclohexane to increased electronic coupling; unlike Si4s-2C, target lifetime does not lengthen.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This explicit negative comparison prevents transferring the stronger-donor trend.

reference_evidence_units.subject: Si2s-2C
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 2, DCM; two Franck-Condon weighting schemes; visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Estimated electronic coupling is 310 or 134 inverse cm depending on model.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Uses shared mean reorganization energy and simplified vibrational weighting; not an independent measurement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: stimulated emission band appears instantaneously for Si2s-2C but exhibits a lag or induction for Si2s-2E
reference_evidence_units.subject: Si2s-2C and Si2s-2E
reference_evidence_units.statement: Stimulated emission appears promptly for the dicyano target, unlike the weaker diester comparator.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Instantaneous means within instrument response, not zero-time molecular dynamics.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Intramolecular CT state character and optical CT transition describe the same pathway as PET, not an independent aggregation mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Source resolves photoinduced charge separation and back-electron transfer; the measured regime is solution photophysics, not AIE.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific restriction of intramolecular motion is established in the selected evidence; aggregation alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No packing, host or matrix constraint on target photophysics is established in the selected evidence.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target host-guest binding mechanism is established; ordinary solvent polarity is not host inclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Intramolecular CT state character and optical CT transition describe the same pathway as PET, not an independent aggregation mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No excited-state proton-transfer photophysics is established. Ground-state protonation or hydrogen bonding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Source resolves photoinduced charge separation and back-electron transfer; the measured regime is solution photophysics, not AIE.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific aggregate exciton, excimer or exciplex assignment is established; aggregation or close packing alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or bright/dark-state balance mechanism is established beyond the other pathways; intensity and lifetime alone are insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific triplet, metal-centered or energy-transfer pathway is established; metal binding alone is insufficient.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection access mechanism is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or suppression of Kasha's rule is established.
